projects.name: Atlas Dashboard
projects.summary: Real-time analytics dashboard for logistics teams.
projects.description: Atlas visualizes fleet telemetry for logistics operators. The main challenge was rendering thousands of live position updates per minute without dropping frames. I designed a virtualized chart layer and a worker-backed data pipeline that keeps the UI thread free.
projects.role: Lead front-end engineer; owned architecture and rendering performance.
projects.outcome: Reduced time-to-interactive by 60% and supported 5k concurrent updates.

projects.name: Relay CLI
projects.summary: A zero-config deployment tool for static sites.
projects.description: Relay wraps common build and deploy steps into a single command. It detects the framework, builds the project, and pushes to any configured host. I focused on clear error output and safe defaults.

projects.name: Form Kit
projects.description: A small library of unstyled form controls with built-in keyboard and screen-reader support. Every primitive is tested against WCAG AA and ships without runtime dependencies.
